cases.instruction: A service uses filelock to take an exclusive lock at a path inside a directory an unprivileged local attacker can write to, then writes secrets to a sibling file. Audit the Unix lock-acquisition path for file-system semantics that let the attacker choose which file is opened when the lock is taken. Report the exact sink line and explain how the attacker-influenced path can truncate a file other than the lock. This is the Unix path only.
